title: Veterans Pension Care-Cost Adjustments — Veteran's Benefit Income by Age of His Statement
content:
**Desk guidance — Veterans Pension care-cost rate adjustment.** In a care-cost rate adjustment the veteran's benefit income is taken by recency of his benefit income statement — the most recently received statement on the award in which the veteran certified his benefit income — counted in days from the date VA received it to the date of the adjustment.

| Statement received | Veteran's benefit income used |
|---|---|
| within the fresh period: 90 days or fewer before the adjustment | the statement, as stated |
| more than 90 days but no more than 365 days (one year) before | the higher of the statement and the benefit income on the award |
| no statement received within 365 days | the benefit income on the award |

The benefit income on the award is the countable income on the award less the spouse's annual figure on file.

## Applying the table (hypothetical figures: statement 21000.00; benefit income on the award 18000.00)

- Statement received 90 days ago: 21000.00.
- Received 91 days ago: the higher of 21000.00 and 18000.00, which is 21000.00. Had the statement been 16000.00, the higher figure would be the 18000.00 on the award.
- Received 365 days ago: still the higher of the two.
- Received 366 days ago, or no statement on file: 18000.00.
